slice: F02-R — Production Remediation of the F02 Host Tag Collision
supersedes: Angular-Wave2-S5VR-TEST-CORRECTION-EVIDENCE (S5-VR preserved the F02 defect as expected-failures; F02-R REMEDIATES it in production)
designDecisionReference: Angular-Wave2-S5D-REMEDIATION-DESIGN (Option A — selector divergence — ACCEPTED by Lead)
authorization: Lead F02-R directive (after accepting S5-D Option A): GO — ONE bounded production remediation increment. (1) change packages/angular/src/select.component.ts selector to 'smilodon-angular-select' + update JSDoc/comments; do NOT alter lifecycle, CVA, event bridge, provenance, or loader. (2) update README, 4 AOT consumer usages, 2 SSR fixture usages. (3) update render-server.mjs host-count regex while preserving hydration marker + node-identity assertions. (4) convert all 3 F02 test.fail() reproductions into genuine passing tests; REPLACE the foreign-shadow-root slot assertion with a positive check that the Angular host has NO foreign shadow root and independent widget visibility/interaction. (5) W01-W06: shadow-aware focus, exact event counts, exact initial form callback counts, real pointer+keyboard, genuine focus-loss/touched. (6) run gates, regenerate evidence MD/JSON + SHA256SUMS, one bounded commit. Also required: mixed-consumer regression (full core loaded must not upgrade the smilodon-angular-select host). WebKit = unverified environmental.
dependencyNotes: No dependency changes. Uses existing Angular 21.2.26, @playwright/test 1.59.1, vitest 4.1.12.
headlineOutcome: The F02 adapter defect is REMEDIATED. The Angular host selector was diverged from the colliding `<smilodon-select>` tag (upgraded by core's slotless NativeSelectElement) to a tag core never registers — `smilodon-angular-select`. The host is no longer upgraded by core, so the light-DOM `<enhanced-select>` widget renders, is sized, hit-testable, and is fully operable by real pointer and keyboard. The three S5-VR expected-failures are now GENUINE PASSES. A mixed-consumer regression test confirms that importing the full core (which registers `smilodon-select`) does not upgrade the Angular host. All regression gates pass; WebKit remains unverified-environmental.

productionChange.scope: Selector string only, plus JSDoc/comment references updated to the new tag. Lifecycle hooks, ControlValueAccessor, event bridge (SMILODON_SELECT_EVENT_NAMES), provenance probes, and the browser-deferred core-loader (ensureEnhancedSelectDefined) are UNCHANGED. The component still renders `<enhanced-select #host>` in its template exactly as every sibling adapter does.
productionChange.breakingNote: For any existing consumer source that used the `<smilodon-select>` Angular selector, this is a BREAKING rename. Accepted by the Lead per S5-D without a runtime shim/alias because the Wave-2 Angular package is unpublished (npm 404) and there is no existing runtime contract to preserve; the rename is documented in the README.

F02R01_selector.title: Angular host selector diverged to 'smilodon-angular-select'
F02R01_selector.detail: select.component.ts line 112 now reads `selector: 'smilodon-angular-select'`. Verified in the built FESM (packages/angular/dist/fesm2022/smilodon-angular.mjs: selector: "smilodon-angular-select") and in the compiled AOT fixture.

F02R02_fullCoreImportCannotUpgradeHost.title: Importing full core (registers smilodon-select) does NOT upgrade the Angular host
F02R02_fullCoreImportCannotUpgradeHost.detail: The Angular adapter's browser-deferred loader imports the FULL @smilodon/core entry, whose module top-level self-registers `smilodon-select` (native-select.ts:562-563), `enhanced-select` (enhanced-select.ts:9107-9108), and `select-option` (select-option.ts:632-633). Because the Angular host tag is `smilodon-angular-select` — a name core never registers — the host element is never upgraded and gains no shadow root. Mixed-consumer regression test asserts customElements.get('smilodon-select')!=null && host.shadowRoot===null && widget has non-zero geometry && pointer-open works.

F02R03_widgetVisibleNonZeroGeometry.title: The widget is visible with non-zero geometry and hit-testable
F02R03_widgetVisibleNonZeroGeometry.detail: `#plain enhanced-select` is visible with a layout box (width>0, height>0). elementFromPoint at the widget centre lands inside the widget's light DOM OR its open shadow tree. The Angular host has height>0.

F02R04_pointerAndKeyboard.title: Real Playwright pointer AND keyboard interaction succeed
F02R04_pointerAndKeyboard.detail: Pointer: click the widget combobox (actionability-checked real gesture) opens the listbox and renders options; clicking the first option selects it. Keyboard: focus the reactive combobox, ArrowDown (open) + ArrowDown + ArrowDown + Enter commits an option into the form model. No programmatic container.click() is used anywhere.

F02R05_expectedFailuresNowPass.title: The three S5-VR expected-failures are genuine passes; the foreign-shadow slot assertion is replaced
F02R05_expectedFailuresNowPass.detail: All three `test.fail(...)` markers were removed. (a) 'tag collision does NOT hide the real widget' -> 'remediated host is NOT upgraded by core; the real widget is visible, sized, hittable'. The old assertion `hostShadowHasSlot === true` (which required the foreign, slot-bearing shadow root) was REMOVED and replaced by a POSITIVE assertion that the host has NO foreign shadow root (`host.shadowRoot === null`) plus widget visibility/size/hittability. (b) 'collision does NOT suppress layout' -> genuine geometry test (client rects>0, width/height>0, hit-test inside). (c) 'REAL focus cannot reach the widget' -> 'REAL focus reaches the widget combobox (shadow-aware composed focus)'. Zero expected/unexpected/flaky results reported.
F02R05_expectedFailuresNowPass.verdict: CONFIRMED — all 10 tests pass in both engines, 0 expected-failures

F02R06_ssrSerializationAndNodeReuse.title: SSR serialization + hydration node reuse still pass with the new tag
F02R06_ssrSerializationAndNodeReuse.detail: Server HTML serializes 2 `<smilodon-angular-select>` hosts each containing an empty `<enhanced-select>` placeholder, with `ngh` annotations and the `<!--nghm-->` integrity marker. render-server.mjs host-count regex updated to `<smilodon-angular-select\b` (still asserts 2 hosts, 2 placeholders, no combobox/listbox server-side, core not evaluated). hydrate-server.mjs stamp script still targets `app-ssr-shell,#plain,#plain enhanced-select` (ID/tag based, tag-agnostic to the host rename) and hydrate-client.ts node-reuse detection is ID/inner-tag based. Client log: 'hydrated 4 component(s) and 9 node(s), 0 component(s) were skipped'; window.__serverNodesReused === true.

F02R07_exactlyOneChangePerSelection.title: Exactly ONE (change) output per selection
F02R07_exactlyOneChangePerSelection.detail: The F03 selection test now asserts window.__fixture.changeCount === 1 exactly (not >=1) after a single pointer selection; lastChange.selectedValues === ['a']. For the keyboard path, formChanges increments by EXACTLY one and formLastValue is a valid option value.

F02R08_zeroFeedbackOnInitialValue.title: Initial reactive value produces ZERO feedback callbacks
F02R08_zeroFeedbackOnInitialValue.detail: The H2 test asserts window.__fixture.formChanges === 0 exactly after hydration (initial writeValue 'b'), host stays ng-untouched AND ng-pristine, and the standalone change output did not fire (changeCount === 0).

F02R09_realFocusLossMarksTouched.title: A genuine focus-loss marks the control ng-touched
F02R09_realFocusLossMarksTouched.detail: Real Playwright focus moves into the widget combobox (control stays NOT untouched-only via toHaveClass ng-untouched before focus), then real focus moves OUT to an appended visible button (`#focus-sink`); the control transitions to ng-touched (exactly-once touched per session is a component invariant). The synthetic FocusEvent unit check is retained separately.

F02R10_noBehaviorOrCoreChange.title: S1-S4 behavior and core selection unchanged
F02R10_noBehaviorOrCoreChange.detail: Angular unit (62), Angular SSR (4), AOT consumer (PASSED), core unit (1071 + 1 skip), core SSR (10), and core tsc (44 pre-existing) are all unchanged vs the accepted baseline. No core source, registration strategy, runtime dependency, or selection-contract change was made. Sibling adapters (Vue/Svelte/Solid/Vanilla/RN-Web) already render `<enhanced-select>` directly and are untouched.

shadowAwareFocusNote: W02: `document.activeElement` stops at a shadow host. The focus test walks `element.shadowRoot.activeElement` down the open shadow chain to the deepest focused element and asserts it equals the widget's `input[role="combobox"]` AND lies inside the Angular host's composed subtree.

webkit.reason: Host system missing WebKit launch libraries (libicu74, libxml2, libflite1, ...). Launch fails before any test body runs. NOT an application defect. Project remains wired for a host with the system libraries (npx playwright install-deps).

recommendation.summary: The F02 host tag collision is remediated via selector divergence (S5-D Option A). The Angular host is `smilodon-angular-select`, which core never upgrades; the `<enhanced-select>` widget renders, is sized/hittable, and is fully pointer- and keyboard-operable in Chromium and Firefox. The three prior expected-failures are genuine passes and the obsolete foreign-shadow-slot assertion is replaced with a positive no-foreign-shadow check. A mixed-consumer regression test proves the host is not upgraded even when full core (registering `smilodon-select`) is loaded.
recommendation.nextGate: Final Angular SSR/browser qualification (separate gate). Angular release remains BLOCKED until that qualification is run and accepted.
